name: 7Road Holdings Limited
summary: 7Road Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in research, development, operation, and publication of games in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers web and mobile games, including DDTank, Wartune, Mythic Glory, Island Story, DRAGON OATH, and DDTank Adventure series. It is also involved in publishing online games; online game development, promotion and management; and cloud computing and other related services, such as elastic computing, storage, graphics processing unit computing, and security. 7Road Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Wuxi, China.
